lines: * [ENHANCEMENT] Compactor: Add the `cortex_compactor_blocks_marked_for_no_compaction_by_level_total` metric, which tracks blocks marked for no-compaction by reason and by the compaction level of the marked block. #16737

* [ENHANCEMENT] Usage-tracker: Read the tenant shards a chunk at a time when taking a snapshot, releasing the shard lock between chunks, instead of cloning the whole shard under the lock. Series tracking requests no longer wait for the clone. #16892

* [ENHANCEMENT] Usage-tracker: Load the snapshots of the other zone into a shard that already has series a batch at a time, releasing the shard lock between batches. Series tracking requests no longer wait for a whole shard snapshot to be loaded. #16892

-* [ENHANCEMENT] Query-scheduler: Add experimental queue reservation, enabled with `-query-scheduler.queue-reservation-enabled`, with the timeout `-query-scheduler.queue-reservation-timeout`. A query-frontend that supports it can reserve queue slots for a group of sub-requests. The query-scheduler admits or rejects each reservation as a whole. Idle reserved slots count against `-query-scheduler.max-outstanding-requests-per-tenant`. Rejected reservations count in `cortex_query_scheduler_reservations_rejected_total`. The query-frontend does not send reservations yet. #16935

+* [ENHANCEMENT] Query-scheduler, query-frontend: Add experimental queue reservation, enabled with `-query-scheduler.queue-reservation-enabled` and `-query-frontend.queue-reservation-enabled`. Before the query-frontend sends the remote execution sub-requests of a query evaluation, it reserves queue slots for them on one query-scheduler. The query-scheduler can then reject the whole evaluation before it dispatches any sub-request. Idle reserved slots count against `-query-scheduler.max-outstanding-requests-per-tenant`. The query-scheduler closes an idle reservation after `-query-scheduler.queue-reservation-timeout`. Added metrics `cortex_query_scheduler_queue_reservation_enabled`, `cortex_query_scheduler_reservation_slots`, `cortex_query_scheduler_reservations_closed_total`, `cortex_query_scheduler_reservations_rejected_total` and `cortex_query_frontend_queue_reservations_total`, and the `reservation_lost` and `reservation_timed_out` outcomes to `cortex_query_frontend_enqueue_requests_total`. #16935 #17106
* [ENHANCEMENT] Query-frontend: Queries using the `topk()` and `bottomk()` aggregations with a constant `k` are now shardable. #16922
* [ENHANCEMENT] Query-frontend: Queries using the `histogram_avg()` function are now shardable. #16921
* [ENHANCEMENT] All: Reduce the memory that YAML encoding allocates for large documents. #16926

The number of shards to use when doing parallelisation via query sharding. 0 to disable query sharding for tenant. Values greater than 1 are rounded up to the next power of two, so the query shard count always meshes with the compactor's power-of-two shard count. This allows querier to not search the blocks which cannot possibly have the series for given query shard. (default 16)
False to disable query statistics tracking. When enabled, a message with some statistics is logged for every query. (default true)
